I've accepted round 449 and planned round 450 as the RETRO; the decision is **CONTINUE**. The advisor was available and I consulted it twice: after orientation, and before hand-off. No app source was touched; the store is still clean at `a8599a2`.

**Round 449 (D-29z1597).** C passed it: 0 bugs, real browser checks done. Gate 449 published `a8599a2`, which is the baseline for round 450. Only the Safari row was blocked, because the cloud has no WebKit. STORE-2b-3a (gradient heading text) is done.
- The code reviewer flagged a Medium: the new test checks only CSS for gradient text, not TSX. I kept it Medium. My own grep found one TSX hit, in a component nothing imports (`CinemaCurtainLoader`), so nothing live is affected.
- Gate 449's Lows were attached to existing ids or deferred.
- Two items were logged. C's HEAD-vs-HEAD Studio pixel check differed in 2 of 3 runs, though the PASS stands. The mock API was down for both A and C.

**Round 450 = RETRO for rounds 435–449.** The old `b-next.json` said 436–449; the retro policy says 435–449, so I used that. A has nothing to do. C checks that every number and cause in the retro can be traced, runs the auth guard and a Studio smoke test at both viewports, re-captures the screens, and re-runs the claims script (K1–K31).

What the retro found:
- **Cost:** $264.79 for 15 rounds, round median $17.87 (target was $17.00), B's share 75 %.
- **Verdicts:** 14 C passes, 1 fail (round 438). Saba reported no new issues in this window.
- **Screen:** the permanent text-line counts are unchanged since RETRO 435.
- **Lessons:** three new clauses and one evidence id; the file stays at 60 lines and all ids are kept. The clauses come from the `tech-lead` consult:
  - L4: when a test or module is rewritten or ported, every check the old version made must carry over.
  - L22: if A stops on an unruled Medium, C writes a short FAIL even when every row passes. This happened twice (rounds 439 and 442): both were published before I had ruled on the Medium.
  - L60: no `git stash` or shell string-replace edits in the store tree.
- **New systemic task:** `SYS-R450-STORE-STYLE-SCAN`, a test-only round that gives the two Store style-scan tests one shared helper. It closes the Medium above plus 6 Lows and runs before STORE-2b-3b.
- **For Saba:** five Low screen candidates (SR-450-1…5) wait for his answer, and he has seven questions (Q1–Q7), each with a default.
- **For root:** I filed a non-blocking proposal that the gate never publish while a Medium is unruled, and re-raised the Firefox install request (still only Chromium on the runner).

**One disagreement for Saba.** `tech-lead` reads CLAUDE.md as needing his permission to delete the dead Store files. I read his 2026-11-10 legacy-removal policy as that permission: I confirmed by grep that nothing outside barrel files imports these files. The exception is TestimonialsSection, which holds keep-list content. Saba is told in Q6 and can stop the deletion before stage 2b-3d.

**Next.** Round 451 is the regression round if it is planned on or after 2026-11-13; otherwise it is the systemic task. Then STORE-2b-3b, 3c and 3d. STEM-LANES moves ahead as soon as Saba answers. The next RETRO is round 465.
